batch: Revamp S2 Customer Work: CX PR 2b, the Requests page on the shared sub-tabs, the segmented filter, row-link rows, the workspaces table with a row menu, and the Create, Join, Team and Leave dialogs
kind: Requests to docs/revamp/specs/customer-experience.md; uses the shared SubTabs, RowList, SegmentedFilter, Dialog and OverflowMenu in components/ux (S4 owns sub-tabs; nothing forked).
findingsNote: No gap is created or changed. No route, table, migration, switch, provider, payment or write is added.
status: Built on branch revamp/customer over main 74b3681d (PR 300). CI on the exact pushed head is the verifier; see the pull request for its result.
newFiles: apps/web/app/account/requests-tabs.tsx (Requests, Workspaces, Saved tabs; old #work-list, #customer-workspaces and #customer-requests links still land)
apps/web/app/account/work-filter.tsx (the filter applies at once and keeps other query words; a no-script GET form stays as the fallback)
apps/web/components/ux/menu-link.tsx (MenuLink split out of overflow-menu so a plain anchor row, MenuAnchor, needs no next/link)

tests/operator/revamp-cx2b-requests.spec.ts (12: CX-01 length with six requests, CX-04 tabs and filter, CX-05 axe at 390 and 1440), revamp-cx2b-workspaces.spec.ts (5: CX-05 menu and dialogs by keyboard, Escape and focus return, axe, CX-07 screenshots)
docs/design-system/evidence/revamp-cx2b (after screenshots; the before images are revamp-cx2/before)
changedFiles: apps/web/app/account/page.tsx: the Requests view is RequestsTabs; ids my-work, customer-workspaces, customer-requests and 'Manage your work' are kept
apps/web/app/account/work-list.tsx and work-rows.tsx: rows are one link each (RowLink), first ten rows and a Show more button

apps/web/app/account/customer-workspaces.tsx: a table, one actions menu per row (New Request, Continue a Saved Draft, Send a Private Request, Edit or View Company Profile, Plan Delegations, Paid-Service Requests, Plan and Billing, Manage Team, Leave Workspace); Create and Join are dialogs; Team and Leave open in dialogs from the menu. A saved creation retry opens the Create dialog by itself so it is never out of sight
customer-workspace-team.tsx, customer-workspace-leave.tsx, customer-workspace-invitation.tsx: optional bare, open, startAsking and onCancel modes; defaults and every request they send are unchanged
components/ux row-list, dialog (keepMounted, Tab wrap), segmented-filter (count may be text), overflow-menu, customer-bar (MenuLink import)

decisions.tests: Ten existing operator specs followed the new interactions with the same assertions: the action row and More menu became the row menu, 'Manage team' became a menu item that opens the Team dialog, 'Join a workspace' became a button that opens the dialog, the create form sits in the Create dialog. Two specs use exact text matching because the mounted Team dialog title repeats the workspace name. cq-52-70-ui.spec.ts CQ-52 now asserts the same link pairs from the menu (New Request first). No assertion was weakened, skipped or deleted.
decisions.tabs: A link whose target is in another tab opens that tab itself (tested by clicking, with no manual tab click). No panel is given a display value by id, so [hidden] holds.
decisions.manage: 'Manage your work' stays on the Workspaces tab in this PR; moving it to Account is PR 3.

receipts.operator: The ten workspace specs, cq-52-70, member-roles, workspace-team, workspace-invitation, organisation-links, customer-workspaces, programmes, billing, service-requests and wave6, plus the two new specs: all pass after the edits (first full run 113 passed, 26 old-interaction failures, then fixed and re-run).
receipts.length: CX-01 Requests is held in customer-page-length.spec.ts (empty state, 1.0 screen at 390 and 1440 on a production build) and in the operator fixture with six requests (fits 1 screen at 1440 x 900 and 2 at 390 x 844 with a 56 px bar allowance).

notRun: Requests with real workspaces on a production build: the verification seed has none; the table is measured through the fixture.
A screen reader walk-through of the row menu and dialogs.
The Team, Leave and Join flows against the real database: they use the same components and requests as before and keep their existing operator specs.
sensitive: Yes, for review only: the Team, Leave and Join controls moved into dialogs. Their requests, authority checks and copy are unchanged; no new write, route or authority.
